input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§ 2(d)) is one-directional: it confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface but says nothing about Client. Nothing gives Client ownership of, or any licence to, the results/work product of the Support Services Client pays for (§ 10(b) treats those results only as confidential), and there is no affirmative statement that Client retains rights in its Intellectual Property or its borrower/loan data, so the clause fails even the fallback. We cure this with one concise inserted Section 2(e) giving Client ownership and assignment of Support Services deliverables and work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP (use, modify, sublicense), Client retention of its IP and data, and no joint ownership, while leaving TrueLink's retention of its Interface rights intact. We note but do not redline the § 8(d) non-exclusive licence over Credit Data: it is a licence rather than an assignment and is expressly carved out.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Client owns, and TrueLink hereby assigns to Client, all right, title and interest in all deliverables and work product of the Support Services created for Client, and to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such deliverables, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of such deliverables. Except for the license granted in Section 8(d), Client retains all right, title and interest in Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface. No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms only TrueLink's rights in the Interface, so we have added the Client side in a new Section 2(e): we own the deliverables and work product of the Support Services we pay for (with a licence back to any embedded TrueLink IP), we retain our Intellectual Property and our data, and there is no joint ownership. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface and the Section 8(d) Credit Data licence are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Insert Client-side ownership clause: assignment of Support Services deliverables/work product, licence-back of embedded TrueLink IP, Client retention of its IP and data, no joint ownership
